title: Comprehensive Automated Test Suite & Audit for All Tools, Subagents, and Pipeline Invariants
summary: Conducted a rigorous audit and built an exhaustive automated test suite (27 dedicated agent tests, 104 total crate tests) covering all standard tools, subagents, and pipeline transitions. Eradicated naked unwraps in production paths (tasks.rs lines 38 and 1740). Fixed parameter parsing in reject_task and question to accept explicit task_id / taskId arguments. Upgraded glob_match with a recursive slice-based pattern matcher supporting **, *, and ?. Verified all pipeline transitions (advance_task, move_task, reject_task rollback, CHANGES_REQUESTED, ironclad backlog boundary protection), subagent card manipulation isolation, async delegation and batch collection, human-in-the-loop pausing/unblocking and abort handling, worktree filesystem security and output spilling, and cvh-dev 7-tool gating.
